title: lilium canadense var. pardalinum
intro: Lilium canadense var. pardalinum, commonly known as the Canadian tiger lily or western tiger lily, is a variety of the lily plant native to western North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lilium canadense var. pardalinum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce pain and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
